title: MM-SpuBench: Towards Better Understanding of Spurious Biases in Multimodal LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs using Visual Question Answering (VQA) accuracy and a novel Conditional Generation Likelihood Advantage (CGLA) metric on the MM-SpuBench dataset. The benchmark tests the models' reliance on nine categories of superficial visual and textual correlations (Background, Texture and Noise, Co-occurring Objects, Relative Size, Colorization, Orientation, Lighting and Shadows, Perspective and Angle, and Shape) rather than core object attributes.
